name: Michal Grygarek
biography: Michal has 20+ years of experience in the development of electronic systems and radio engineering. He specializes in cyber security of embedded systems, especially with relation to nanometer scale attack. His key expertise includes the methodology of decapsulation, delayering of silicon chips and their subsequent analysis using optical and electron microscopy.
